Huan had been given in adoption to succeed his paternal granduncle Qiu, Secretariat Director, and therefore took the style name Yansun.
從祖 names a paternal relative of the grandfather generation (paternal granduncle), not a father's cousin (從父/從伯); 出繼從祖中書令球 requires that correction.

Huan was adopted out to succeed his paternal granduncle, the Secretariat Director Qiu; hence his style name Yansun.
